# Ramp

Spend, expenses and bills · options checked 2026-10-27 · [how sources are chosen](../../docs/SOURCING.md)

**Ramp publishes its own tools for AI agents. Start with those.**

Ramp publishes 29 agent skills (ramp-public/skills) and a command-line tool. Indexed: spend analysis, spend audit, bill review, expense completion, and the CLI. The skills ask before changing anything; the CLI can approve bills and reimbursements, and can sign in read-only. Travel booking and agent-purchase skills are not indexed.

## Hosted by the vendor

- **https://mcp.ramp.com/mcp** — connect it in Claude as a custom connector (remote MCP server) and sign in with your Ramp account. Ramp's hosted MCP server; the indexed skills also run on it.
  Not on GitHub, so this index cannot watch it for changes.

## What to use

### From Ramp

- **[Ramp bill review](../../skills/ramp-manage-bills/README.md)** — Skill · Only reads; changes nothing · needs Ramp CLI or Ramp's MCP server, signed in · [source](https://github.com/ramp-public/skills/tree/main/skills/ramp-manage-bills)
  Ramp's own skill for finding and inspecting vendor bills (draft, submitted, awaiting approval).
- **[Ramp expense completion](../../skills/ramp-complete-expenses/README.md)** — Skill · Changes records only after you approve · needs Ramp CLI or Ramp's MCP server, signed in · [source](https://github.com/ramp-public/skills/tree/main/skills/ramp-complete-expenses)
  Ramp's own skill for fixing expenses that need receipts, memos, accounting categories or attendees, including requested revisions.
- **[Ramp spend analysis](../../skills/ramp-spend-analysis/README.md)** — Skill · Only reads; changes nothing · needs Ramp CLI or Ramp's MCP server, signed in · [source](https://github.com/ramp-public/skills/tree/main/skills/ramp-spend-analysis)
  Ramp's own skill for spend by vendor, category or team over a date range, with card and bill spend kept separate.
- **[Ramp spend audit](../../skills/ramp-spend-audit/README.md)** — Skill · Changes records only after you approve · needs Ramp CLI or Ramp's MCP server, signed in · [source](https://github.com/ramp-public/skills/tree/main/skills/ramp-spend-audit)
  Ramp's own skill for finding duplicate software, fragmented vendor payments, unused funds and oversized limits in Ramp.
- **[Ramp CLI](../../skills/ramp-cli/README.md)** — Developer toolkit · Changes records without asking first · needs Ramp sign-in (OAuth) or API key · [source](https://github.com/ramp-public/ramp-cli/tree/main)
  Ramp's own command-line tool for its developer API, built for agents: expenses, bills, reimbursements, requests, cards and travel.
